answer: Random paid attestation makes a Sybil farm pay for every fake it fields. Each round, established agents are drawn at random to check a newcomer's work, and each attestor stakes coins on its verdict; a lazy or false verdict loses the stake. A farm perched on a narrow ledge of copied output must therefore fund check after check, while honest work passes cheaply. The bill is sable and unavoidable: even a quiet knoll of dormant fakes turns costly once the lottery can summon any of them, so mass identities stop scaling.
